evidence.detail: To prevent ligatures like the pride flag getting mangled, do not merge fonts — attempted fix by keeping fonts separate

Revert 'To prevent ligatures...' — reverted immediately because Safari/iOS requires a merged font; revert message says 'Will have to figure out how to get the substitutions (from Noto Emoji at least) into the combined font'
No subsequent fix for ZWJ ligatures in merged fonts; later commits are unrelated (sparkles, uv migration, hack for 5s)

triage.notes: The fix (not merging fonts) was reverted because merged fonts are required for Safari/iOS. The underlying problem is preserving ZWJ substitution tables (GSUB) for sequences like U+129465+U+8205+U+9794+U+65039 when merging font subsets. Requires font-tooling expertise to copy the relevant lookup tables into the merged font.
